 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 25, 2026, 6:20 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FINAL Last update 6:20 PM ET 6:20 PM ET 11 minutes ago HALFTIME
 Sandro added two from two free throws, with two from Svi Myhailiuk, followed by two from Matisse Thybulle, plus a point from two free throws from Lauri Markkanen, two from Luka Doncic and one more from a free throw, as well as three from the shot, putting the score at 74 to 71 for the Lakers!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments
 6:20 PM ET HALFTIME 
 5:51 PM ET 2nd Q Starts 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 2' 6:17 PM ET 13 minutes ago Four points lead
 Sandro Mamukelashvili scored three points, with Lauri Makkanen adding three in quick succession, plus two from two free throws by Sandro. Sandro then scored two points, followed by three from Keyonte George, and two from Luka Doncic, bringing the score to 68-64 for the Jazz.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 6:09 PM ET 21 minutes ago Seven points lead
 Ziaire Williams scored two points on two free throws. Jaren Jackson Jr. also scored two points, with Ziaire Williams then adding three points in a low-scoring moment, bringing the score to 62-55 for the Jazz.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 6:08 PM ET 22 minutes ago 10 points lead
 Austin Reaves scored one point on two free throws, with Keyonte George scoring one on two. Walker Kessler added two points, followed by three from Austin Reaves, and then Keyonte George adding two points, bringing the score to 60-50!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 6:04 PM ET 26 minutes ago 12 points lead
 Collin Sexton scored two points, with Brice Sensabaugh also scoring two. Austin Reaves added three, followed by three more, plus two from Jaxson Hayes, bringing the current score to 57-43 for the Jazz over the Lakers.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 5:58 PM ET 32 minutes ago 18 points lead
 Collin Sexton added two points, with Brice Sensabaugh adding two, as well as two points on two free throws by Austin Reaves. Jaxson Hayes added two points, with Austin Reaves adding two, plus two on two Isaiah Collier free throws, putting the score at 53-35!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:51 PM ET 40 minutes ago 2nd Q Starts
 Isaiah Collier scored two points, with Lauri Markkanen adding three, followed by two free throws from Luka Doncic, plus three from Doncic in quick succession, with Jaren Jackson Jr. adding two and another on a foul, in addition to Collin Sexton adding two free throws, with two more from Lauri Markkanen, followed by two from Quentin Grimes, plus Ace Bailey with two points, and three from Lauri Markkanen, to put the score at 47-29 for the Jazz at the start of the second quarter.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 2' 5:45 PM ET an hour ago 12 points lead
 Kevon Looney scored two points on two free throws, with Brice Sensabaugh adding three points, two on two free throws, and three points in a row, bringing the score to 32-20 for the Utah Jazz in the game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4' 5:38 PM ET an hour ago 16 points lead
 Ace Bailey scored two points, followed by three more from Jaxson Hayes. Luka Doncic added a point from two free throws, along with two points from Keyonte George, plus another from a foul, to put the team ahead by a huge 16 points, making it 29-13!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 6' 5:32 PM ET an hour ago Seven points lead
 Luka Doncic scored two points, with Jaren Jackson Jr. adding three in quick succession, followed by three from Matisse Thybulle. Darryn Peterson scored two points, followed by two from Ace Bailey, with three from Ziaire Williams, bringing the score to 19-12!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 8' 5:27 PM ET an hour ago Eight points lead
 Lauri Markkanen scored two points, followed by two more from Luka Doncic. Ace Bailey also scored two points, followed by two more, in a game dominated by the Jazz, who now lead 12-4 at this early stage of the game.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 5:21 PM ET an hour ago Start with points
 Luka Doncic scored two points off the first inning, along with two from Ace Bailey, two from Jaren Jackson Jr., and two from Lauri Markkanen, to put the Jazz up 6-2 in the score at the start of the game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:16 PM ET an hour ago HERE WE GO
 The players stepped onto the court and the ball flew for the Lakers vs. Jazz matchup in this first quarter of the NBA regular season game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL! And, after the start, the first possession belongs to the Lakers!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:10 PM ET an hour ago Starting five
 And here are the starting five for today's game! For the Los Angeles Lakers, the lineup is: Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Austin Reaves, and Luka Doncic. For the Utah Jazz, the lineup is: Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr., and Ace Bailey.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5:00 PM ET 2 hours ago Tomorrow's games
 Tomorrow we continue with nine more matchups on Monday's games: Cavaliers vs Timberwolves, Hornets vs Wizards, Celtics vs Bulls, Heat vs Mavericks, Thunder vs Suns, Bucks vs Pacers, Rockets vs Hawks, Jazz vs Grizzlies, and Nuggets vs Warriors.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:54 PM ET 2 hours ago Today's games
 The game later today kicks off this Sunday of NBA games. Later today we also have Nets vs Pacers, Knicks vs Magic, Thunder vs Clippers, Timberwolves vs Raptors, 76ers vs Pistons, and Kings vs Grizzlies, thus closing out Sunday's games.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:54 PM ET 2 hours ago Yesterday's games
 Eight regular season games took place yesterday, with the following results: Hornets 11-5110 Heat, 76ers 127-116 Bucks, Cavaliers 125-121 Nets, Bulls 120-124 Wizards, Mavericks 106-122 Spurs, Hawks 114-121 Rockets, Nuggets 141-135 Pelicans and Suns 131-122 Warriors.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:51 PM ET 2 hours ago Good afternoon!
 We're kicking off the broadcast of the game, with all the plays and excitement of the duel between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Utah Jazz in this NBA regular season, taking place at the Delta Center in Utah, on Sunday of the 2026-27 season! Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:26 PM ET 2 hours ago Los Angeles Lakers vs Utah Jazz Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
 Follow Los Angeles Lakers vs Utah Jazz live: real-time score, confirmed lineups, points, game statistics, NBA 2026-27 regular season standings and highlights, straight from the Delta Center on VAVEL US.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:19 PM ET 2 hours ago How to watch Los Angeles Lakers vs Utah Jazz Live Stream and TV Online?
 If you want to watch the Los Angeles Lakers vs Utah Jazz game live on TV, your options are: Spectrum SportsNet and KJZZ-TV.
 If you prefer a streaming service or app, your options are: Spectrum SportsNet+, NBA League Pass, and Jazz+.
 If you want to watch online, VAVEL US is your best option to follow the NBA regular season game!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:10 PM ET 2 hours ago Delta Center: Let's go to Utah for today's game!
 Finally, today's game takes place at the Delta Center, located in Salt Lake City, Utah. Home to the Utah Jazz and the Utah Mammoth of the NHL, the arena opened in 1991, underwent renovations in 2010 and 2013, and has a capacity of over 15,000 spectators.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:59 PM ET 3 hours ago Injury Report: Who's out for today's game on the Jazz side?
 On the other side, the Utah Jazz will also have only two injured players, with no players listed as questionable, going into the game without Trey Alexander, with a knee injury, and Jusuf Nurkic, with a foot injury.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:50 PM ET 3 hours ago Injury Report: Who's out for today's game on the Lakers side?
 The Los Angeles Lakers will be without Cameron Carr, with an oblique injury, and Adou Thiero, with a knee injury, both out for today's game, at a time when the Lakers have few injured players and no players listed as questionable.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:20 PM ET 3 hours ago Western Conference: This is how the Lakers stand at the start of the season
 The Los Angeles Lakers, in turn, are in the same conference with two wins and no losses, tied with the Thunder, Grizzlies, Trail Blazers, and Timberwolves. Furthermore, the team is only behind the Rockets, who have three wins, and ahead of the Clippers and Jazz.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 2:45 PM ET 4 hours ago Western Conference: Here's how the Jazz stand at the start of the season
 The Utah Jazz are in eighth place in the Western Conference with one win and one loss, tied with the Clippers, ahead of the Spurs and Mavericks (one win and two losses), the Nuggets and Suns (one loss each), and the Pelicans, Warriors, and Kings (two wins each).
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 2:45 PM ET 4 hours ago How are the Los Angeles Lakers doing for today's game?
 The Los Angeles Lakers, for their part, come into today's games with three wins and two losses. On October 8th, they won 114-110 against the Kings. On Tuesday (13th), they lost 101-89 to the Warriors. And on Friday (16th), they lost 121-106 to the Nuggets, thus closing out the preseason. On Wednesday (21st), they won 127-105 against the Warriors in their regular season opener. And on Friday (23rd), they won 125-117 against the Clippers.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 2:45 PM ET 4 hours ago How does the Utah Jazz arrive for today's game?
 The Utah Jazz come into today's game with three wins and two losses in their last few games. On October 6th, they lost 117-106 to the Nuggets. On Monday (12th), they won against the Spurs. And on Friday (16th), they won 119-116 against the Suns, thus closing out the preseason. On Wednesday (21st), they lost 123-103 to the Grizzlies in their regular season opener. And on Friday (23rd), they won 120-119 against the Pelicans.
 Updates by Victor Cunha

 Los Angeles Lakers vs Utah Jazz face off live this Sunday (25), at the Delta Center, for the NBA .
